name: design-suite
description: A design lead plus five focused skills for UI/UX work: user flows and screen states, interface polish (spacing, type, colour, motion), accessibility review against WCAG 2.2, dashboards, mobile and responsive design, and information architecture. These are AI review perspectives that give specific, checkable findings; they do not replace testing with real users or assistive-technology audits.

interface.shortDescription: Review and shape UI and UX work
interface.longDescription: A design lead plus five focused skills for UI/UX work: user flows and screen states, interface polish (spacing, type, colour, motion), accessibility review against WCAG 2.2, dashboards, mobile and responsive design, and information architecture. These are AI review perspectives that give specific, checkable findings; they do not replace testing with real users or assistive-technology audits.
capabilities: Frames the user task and reviews flows and screen states
Polishes spacing, type, colour and motion with the project's own tokens
Reviews accessibility against WCAG 2.2 AA and lists what still needs real testing
Designs dashboards that show freshness and missing data honestly
Plans mobile, responsive and information-architecture changes
